settings.ai.onHint: When on: ask anytime from the floating ball, see an in-game overlay, and get automatic error analysis. The key is stored encrypted on this machine.
settings.ai.offHint: When off, all of the above is disabled. Your configuration is kept.
settings.ai.formatHint: Pick the protocol your service speaks. Compatible gateways (one-api / new-api / vLLM / LM Studio) usually use OpenAI.
settings.ai.baseUrlHint: Base URL only, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1. The concrete path is appended per format.
settings.ai.keyHint: May be empty (local Ollama or a gateway without auth). A real request is sent before saving.
settings.ai.headersHint: Optional. A JSON object such as {"X-Api-Version":"2024-01"}, or one Key: Value per line.
settings.ai.modelHint: For example gpt-4o-mini, claude-3-5-sonnet-latest, gemini-2.0-flash, qwen2.5:7b.
settings.ai.historyHint: Maximum turns kept in context (1–50). Larger costs more tokens.
settings.ai.autoAnalyzeHint: On launch or install failures, automatically send the error and recent logs to the AI for advice.
settings.ai.toolsHint: When on, the AI may inspect and even modify your instances. Destructive actions always require your confirmation.
ai.title: AI Assistant
ai.placeholder: Ask something… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
ai.emptyHint: For example: why does 1.20.1 crash on launch? Or list my instances.
ai.confirmTitle: AI wants to run an action
ai.askAi: Ask AI to analyze this error
ai.ballTip: Click to chat with the AI assistant
settings.ai.headersBadJson: Headers are not valid JSON — check brackets and quotes
settings.ai.headersNotObject: Headers must be a JSON object, e.g. {"X-Foo":"bar"}
